recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If any stale IG Publisher web-server text remains in Confluence or another external documentation system, update it there rather than changing FHIR source.
issue_request: FHIR-20546 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for STU3-era IG Publisher documentation. It reported broken links in the old "Using the IG Publisher Web Server" section and approved updating that section to say "A web version is not currently supported".
initial_application: No source-side commit mentioning FHIR-20546, the old section title, or the approved replacement sentence was found in the FHIR repository. The issue URL and grouping point to wiki/Confluence documentation, so any initial application appears to have been outside the core source checkout.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is active in the current build, and the current ImplementationGuide introduction only links to the Confluence IG Publisher Documentation page. Current FHIR source does not contain the obsolete wiki anchor, the hapi.fhir.org/igweb URL, the old Web Server section title, or the approved replacement sentence. A later Zulip thread confirms that the web-server reference was obsolete external documentation.
reconciliation: No FHIR source files were changed. The current core source is not carrying the broken web-server links, and the actionable documentation surface is external to this repository/current build.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue reporting broken links in old IG Publisher Web Server documentation and resolving to state that a web version is not currently supported.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request and shows the target was external IG Publisher documentation rather than a named FHIR source artifact.

evidence_items.summary: The active ImplementationGuide introduction links to Confluence IG Publisher Documentation but contains no old web-server section or hapi server URL; fhir.ini marks ImplementationGuide active and approved.
evidence_items.learned: The relevant current FHIR source surface is in build scope and is already free of the broken web-server content.

evidence_items.command: rg -n 'IG_Publisher_Documentation|Using the IG Publisher Web Server|A web version is not currently supported|hapi\\.fhir\\.org/igweb' source .github
evidence_items.query: IG_Publisher_Documentation OR Using the IG Publisher Web Server OR A web version is not currently supported OR hapi.fhir.org/igweb
evidence_items.summary: No matches were found in current source or repository documentation paths checked.
evidence_items.learned: There is no current FHIR source cleanup needed for the obsolete web-server link or approved replacement sentence.

evidence_items.locator: git log --grep FHIR-20546 and pickaxe searches for approved/obsolete phrases
evidence_items.command: git log --all --fixed-strings --grep='FHIR-20546'; git log --all -S 'A web version is not currently supported'; git log --all -S 'Using the IG Publisher Web Server'
evidence_items.summary: No FHIR source commit mentioning FHIR-20546 or carrying the approved replacement wording was found.
evidence_items.learned: The issue appears to have been applied, if at all, in external documentation rather than the FHIR source repository.

evidence_items.summary: A 2021 user reported the hapi.fhir.org/igweb link failing from the Confluence IG Publisher documentation; Grahame Grieve replied that there was no web server and he should remove the reference.
evidence_items.learned: Later community evidence confirms the obsolete web-server reference belonged to external IG Publisher documentation.

evidence_items.command: bun run confluence:search fts '"A web version is not currently supported"' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search fts '"Using the IG Publisher Web Server"' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search fts '"IG Publisher Documentation" "Web Server"' --limit 10
evidence_items.query: A web version is not currently supported; Using the IG Publisher Web Server; IG Publisher Documentation Web Server
evidence_items.summary: No exact indexed Confluence hits were found for the approved sentence, old section title, or page title combined with Web Server.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered current external documentation evidence changes the conclusion that core source should not be edited.
